# Swarm Rebuild (swarmrebuild.xyz)

> Swarm Rebuild is a Chrome extension that wipes any web page to a blank
> canvas and lets a swarm of multiplayer cursors rebuild it live with boxes,
> typed text, pen-tool lines, ruler guides and alt-drag duplicates.

This is an English-only product site. The home page, pricing page and legal
pages are public. The Act action uses Google sign-in and an active paid plan;
the browser extension itself runs locally and does not send page content to a
server.

## Pages

- [Home](https://swarmrebuild.xyz/): the rebuild animation, what the swarm
  rebuilds, how the snapshot/blank/rebuild sequence works, sound design,
  privacy and product limits.
- [Pricing](https://swarmrebuild.xyz/pricing): Solo, Studio and Team plans,
  monthly or annual, paid through Stripe. There is no free tier.
- [Terms of Service](https://swarmrebuild.xyz/terms-of-service)
- [Privacy Policy](https://swarmrebuild.xyz/privacy-policy)

## Key facts

- Product: Swarm Rebuild, a visual page-rebuild Chrome extension.
- Input: any regular web page the user invokes the extension on.
- Output: an animated, local visual rebuild of the page with a multi-cursor
  design-tool choreography.
- Privacy: no analytics or uploads from the extension; page snapshots stay in
  the current tab memory.
- Sign-in: Google. Payments: Stripe hosted checkout, opened directly.
